pages.text: Dusts are powdered materials created by using the Forge Hammer on various items. They are used in crafting and can be combined to create Steel Ingots.$(br)$(br)Available dusts:$(br)• Coal Dust$(br)• Iron Dust$(br)• Nickel Dust$(br)• Steel Dust

pages.title: Coal Dust
pages.text: Created by crushing coal. Used in steel production.

pages.title: Iron Dust
pages.text: Created by crushing iron items. Used in steel production.

pages.title: Nickel Dust
pages.text: Created by crushing nickel items. Used in advanced alloys.

pages.title: Steel Dust
pages.text: Created by crushing steel items. Can be smelted back into Steel Ingots.
